text: What are you pretending *not to know*?
If nothing changed for five more years — would that be *okay*?
Whose approval are you still *writing for*?
What did you love that you quietly *gave up*?
What would you stop doing if *no one was watching*?
What question are you avoiding *writing down*?
What do I keep calling fine that *isn't*?
What would I tell a friend who brought me *this*?
If I said it out loud, what would have to *change*?
What did this week actually *cost* me?
What am I hoping someone will finally *notice*?
What am I still doing only because I *started*?
